description: If a finite ground clause set \(\Delta\subseteq\Gamma^g\) derives \(G\) in the existing propositional premise-and-resolution calculus, some \(C\) derivable from \(\Gamma\) in the specified generalized first-order calculus has an exact ground instance \(C\sigma=G\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.tree_lifting.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (Γ : Set (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.FOClause L ℕ))
  (Δ : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSet (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundAtom L))
  (hΔ : ↑Δ ⊆ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundClauses Γ)
  {G : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundClause L} (d : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Derives Δ G) :
  ∃ C,
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.Derives Γ C ∧
      ∃ σ, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.clauseSubst σ C = G
